snippet.title: Granny has a visitor... again (UNOFFICIAL, Recaptured)
snippet.description:
Buy the original game at https://store.steampowered.com/app/962400/Granny/
Recaptured available for owners of Granny at:
https://gamejolt.com/games/GrannyRecaptured/967513
https://discord.gg/SaGAy5v9jC

Wanted to showcase some of the new stuff in this video!

-Grandpa, with his shotgun from Granny 3
-Randomize mode (rebalances from BMP, adds sink puzzle, random spots for some items)
-Classic music (v1.7.9.3 chase music, original Game Overs)
-Color grading (v1.3.2 style - for those who like the "darker" feel)

This one's a bit longer and more freeform! Hope you like it!
